recipes.title: Keto Butter Paneer (No-Sugar Paneer Makhani)
recipes.description: Soft paneer in a silky tomato–butter gravy finished with cream and kasuri methi. No sugar and only a few cashews, so the classic makhani taste stays within a keto budget.

steps.title: Soak cashews, chop tomatoes
steps.text: Soak the cashews in hot water for 10 minutes so they blend smooth. Roughly chop the tomatoes and cut the paneer into 1-inch cubes.
steps.visual: Ten cashews soaking in a small steel bowl of hot water, chopped red tomatoes and a pile of white paneer cubes on a wooden board

steps.title: Cook the tomato base
steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a kadai over medium heat. Add the bay leaf, cardamom, slit green chilli and ginger-garlic paste and stir for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, drained cashews and salt, cover and cook for 8 minutes until the tomatoes collapse.
steps.visual: Soft, collapsed tomatoes and cashews bubbling in butter in a black kadai, a bay leaf and green chilli peeking through

steps.title: Blend until silky
steps.text: Let the mixture cool for a few minutes, pick out the bay leaf and blend with half the water to a completely smooth purée.
steps.visual: A mixer jar filled with a smooth, bright orange-red tomato–cashew purée, the empty kadai beside it

steps.title: Simmer the makhani gravy
steps.text: Melt the remaining butter in the same kadai, stir in the Kashmiri chilli for 10 seconds, then pour in the purée and the rest of the water. Simmer on low for 5 minutes, stirring, until it coats the spoon.
steps.visual: Glossy, deep orange makhani gravy gently bubbling in the black kadai with a sheen of butter on the surface

steps.title: Add the paneer
steps.text: Slide in the paneer cubes and simmer for 3 minutes so they warm through and soak up the gravy. Don't boil hard or the paneer turns chewy.
steps.visual: White paneer cubes half submerged in the orange gravy in the kadai

steps.title: Finish with cream
steps.text: Turn the heat off. Stir in the cream, garam masala and crushed kasuri methi. Taste and adjust salt.
steps.visual: Swirls of white cream being folded into the paneer makhani in the kadai, flecks of dried fenugreek on top

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with almond-flour roti or cauliflower rice to keep the meal low in carbs.
steps.visual: Butter paneer in a copper-bottomed serving bowl with a swirl of cream and a pinch of kasuri methi, an almond-flour roti on the side

substitutions.note: Use firm tofu and coconut cream for a vegan version; it absorbs the gravy well.
Blanched almonds give the same creaminess with fewer carbs.
Heavy cream is richer; use a little less.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days. The gravy freezes well without the paneer for 1 month.
recipes.reheating: Warm gently over low heat with a splash of water; avoid boiling.

recipes.title: Malai Methi Paneer
recipes.description: A pale, creamy Mughlai-style curry of fresh fenugreek leaves and paneer, mellowed with cream and a little cashew. Slightly bitter, gently spiced and naturally low in carbs.

steps.title: Salt the methi
steps.text: Pick the methi leaves off the stems, chop them and rub with a pinch of salt. Leave for 10 minutes, then squeeze out the green juice — this tames the bitterness.
steps.visual: A heap of chopped bright green fenugreek leaves in a steel bowl, a hand squeezing a ball of leaves with green juice dripping out

steps.title: Make the onion–cashew paste
steps.text: Blend the onion, cashews and green chillies with 4 tablespoons of the water to a smooth, pale paste.
steps.visual: A mixer jar holding a smooth, creamy off-white onion and cashew paste

steps.title: Cook the paste
steps.text: Heat ghee in a kadai over medium heat. Add cumin seeds; when they sizzle add ginger-garlic paste for 30 seconds, then the onion–cashew paste. Stir for 5 to 6 minutes until it thickens and loses its raw smell without browning.
steps.visual: Thick, pale cream-coloured paste being stirred in ghee in a steel kadai, a few cumin seeds visible

steps.title: Wilt the methi
steps.text: Add the squeezed methi leaves and stir for 3 minutes until they darken and soften into the paste.
steps.visual: Dark green wilted fenugreek leaves folded through the pale paste in the steel kadai

steps.title: Simmer with cream
steps.text: Pour in the remaining water and the cream, add black pepper and the rest of the salt, and simmer on low for 3 minutes until creamy.
steps.visual: A smooth ivory gravy speckled with green methi gently simmering in the steel kadai

steps.title: Add paneer and garam masala
steps.text: Add the paneer cubes and garam masala, fold gently and cook for 2 minutes until the paneer is warmed through.
steps.visual: Paneer cubes coated in creamy green-flecked gravy in the steel kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with flaxseed roti or almond-flour roti.
steps.visual: Malai methi paneer in a white ceramic bowl, creamy and pale with green fenugreek flecks, a flaxseed roti folded beside it

substitutions.note: Use 2 tbsp kasuri methi if fresh methi isn't available; skip the salting step.
Blanched almonds work the same way in the paste.
Use firm tofu and coconut cream for a dairy-free version.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Reheat on low with a splash of water; the cream can split if boiled.

recipes.title: Paneer Kofta in Tomato–Cream Gravy
recipes.description: Soft paneer dumplings bound with almond flour instead of potato and cornflour, simmered in a light tomato–cream gravy. A celebratory curry that stays low in carbs.

steps.title: Mix the kofta dough
steps.text: In a mixing bowl knead the grated paneer with the almond flour, chopped green chilli, half the coriander, garam masala and salt for 2 minutes until smooth and crack-free.
steps.visual: A smooth ball of paneer and almond flour dough flecked with green chilli and coriander in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Shape the koftas
steps.text: Divide into 12 portions and roll into smooth balls between oiled palms. Chill for 10 minutes so they hold their shape.
steps.visual: Twelve neat, pale paneer balls lined up on a steel plate

steps.title: Fry the koftas
steps.text: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and shallow-fry the koftas for 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until golden all over. Or brush with oil and air fry at 190°C for 8 minutes.
steps.visual: Golden-brown paneer koftas sizzling in a thin layer of oil in a non-stick pan

steps.title: Cook the masala
steps.text: In a kadai melt the butter, add cumin seeds, then the onion. Cook for 3 minutes until soft, add ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, Kashmiri chilli, coriander powder and salt. Cover and cook for 7 minutes until soft.
steps.visual: Soft, jammy tomatoes and onion in a red-orange masala in a black kadai

steps.title: Blend the gravy
steps.text: Cool slightly and blend the masala with the water until completely smooth, then return it to the kadai.
steps.visual: Smooth, bright orange tomato gravy being poured from a mixer jar back into the black kadai

steps.title: Simmer with cream
steps.text: Simmer the gravy on low for 5 minutes, then stir in the cream and crushed kasuri methi and switch off the heat.
steps.visual: A creamy pale orange gravy in the kadai with a swirl of cream just stirred in

steps.title: Add koftas and serve
steps.text: Place the koftas in a serving bowl and pour the hot gravy over just before serving so they stay soft but intact. Garnish with the remaining coriander.
steps.visual: Golden paneer koftas sitting in creamy orange gravy in a shallow serving bowl, garnished with chopped coriander and a drizzle of cream

substitutions.note: For a nut-free version use about 12 g coconut flour; it absorbs more moisture.
Thick coconut milk makes a dairy-light gravy.
Ghee gives the koftas a richer flavour.

recipes.storage: Store koftas and gravy separately in the fridge for up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Warm the gravy until simmering, then pour over the koftas; reheat koftas briefly in the air fryer.

recipes.title: Keto Paneer Bhurji
recipes.description: Crumbled paneer scrambled with a little onion, tomato and capsicum, finished with a spoon of cream. A ten-minute dhaba favourite for breakfast or a quick dinner.

steps.title: Crumble and chop
steps.text: Crumble the paneer with your fingers into small, uneven pieces. Finely chop the onion, ginger, green chilli, capsicum and tomato.
steps.visual: A bowl of coarsely crumbled white paneer beside small heaps of finely chopped onion, capsicum, tomato, ginger and green chilli on a wooden board

steps.title: Soften the aromatics
steps.text: Melt the butter in a kadai over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle, then the onion, ginger and green chilli. Cook for 2 minutes until the onion is translucent.
steps.visual: Translucent chopped onion, ginger and green chilli with cumin seeds in foaming butter in a black kadai

steps.title: Cook capsicum and tomato
steps.text: Add the capsicum and tomato with turmeric, Kashmiri chilli and salt. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the tomato breaks down into a thick masala.
steps.visual: A thick red-orange masala with soft capsicum bits in the black kadai

steps.title: Scramble the paneer
steps.text: Add the crumbled paneer and garam masala and toss for 2 minutes so every crumb is coated.
steps.visual: Crumbled paneer turning golden-orange as it is tossed through the masala in the kadai

steps.title: Add cream and coriander
steps.text: Lower the heat, stir in the cream and cook for 1 minute until the bhurji is moist. Fold in the coriander.
steps.visual: Soft, moist paneer bhurji with cream folded through and fresh green coriander scattered over in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with almond-flour roti, or in lettuce cups for a lighter plate.
steps.visual: Paneer bhurji piled on a steel plate with a folded almond-flour roti and a few onion rings

substitutions.note: Firm tofu crumbled the same way makes a vegan bhurji; add a pinch of black salt.
Ghee is a fine swap.

recipes.storage: Best eaten fresh; keeps 1 day in the fridge.
recipes.reheating: Warm in a pan with a teaspoon of water.

recipes.title: Palak Egg Bhurji
recipes.description: Soft-scrambled eggs folded through garlicky sautéed spinach, a greener take on anda bhurji that packs plenty of protein into a quick breakfast.

steps.title: Prep the spinach
steps.text: Wash the spinach well in two changes of water, drain and chop finely.
steps.visual: A heap of finely chopped dark green spinach on a wooden board, droplets of water still on the leaves

steps.title: Whisk the eggs
steps.text: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt and whisk until frothy.
steps.visual: Five beaten eggs, pale yellow and frothy, in a steel bowl with a whisk

steps.title: Fry the aromatics
steps.text: Heat ghee in a kadai over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, then onion, garlic and green chilli; sauté for 2 minutes. Add the tomato, turmeric, chilli powder and the rest of the salt and cook for 2 minutes until soft.
steps.visual: Softened onion, garlic and tomato in a reddish masala in a black kadai

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Add the spinach and stir for 3 minutes until it collapses and most of the water evaporates.
steps.visual: Dark wilted spinach mixed into the masala in the black kadai, no liquid pooling

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.text: Lower the heat, pour in the eggs and let them set for 20 seconds, then stir gently with a spatula for 2 to 3 minutes until soft curds form. Sprinkle garam masala and stop while still slightly moist.
steps.visual: Soft yellow egg curds streaked with green spinach in the kadai, still glossy

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve immediately with flaxseed roti or on its own.
steps.visual: Palak egg bhurji heaped in a steel plate, green and yellow, with a wedge of lemon and a flaxseed roti

substitutions.note: Fresh methi gives a slightly bitter, aromatic version.
Mustard oil adds a sharper, Punjabi-dhaba flavour.

recipes.storage: Best eaten fresh.
recipes.reheating: Warm briefly in a pan; eggs turn rubbery in the microwave.

recipes.title: Masala Omelette
recipes.description: The everyday Indian omelette — three eggs with onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander, cooked in butter until golden at the edges.

steps.title: Chop the vegetables
steps.text: Finely chop the onion, tomato (seeds removed so it doesn't water down the eggs), green chilli and coriander.
steps.visual: Tiny cubes of onion, red tomato, green chilli and chopped coriander in small piles on a wooden board

steps.title: Beat the eggs
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with turmeric, chilli powder, pepper and salt until frothy, then stir in the chopped vegetables.
steps.visual: A steel bowl of frothy yellow beaten eggs full of colourful chopped onion, tomato and coriander

steps.title: Cook the omelette
steps.text: Melt the butter on a tawa over medium heat. Pour in the egg mixture and spread it evenly. Cook for 2 minutes until the edges are golden and the top is almost set.
steps.visual: A round masala omelette setting on a black iron tawa, edges turning golden and lacy, vegetables dotted across the surface

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.text: Flip carefully and cook the other side for 1 minute.
steps.visual: The flipped omelette on the tawa showing a golden-brown, spotted surface

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fold in half and serve hot with a cucumber salad or green chutney.
steps.visual: A golden masala omelette folded on a white plate with cucumber slices and a little bowl of green chutney

substitutions.note: Ghee or any oil works.
Capsicum adds crunch with fewer juices.

recipes.storage: Best eaten fresh.

recipes.title: Paneer-Stuffed Omelette
recipes.description: A two-egg omelette folded around a spiced paneer and capsicum filling with a dusting of chaat masala — a filling, protein-rich breakfast.

steps.title: Make the paneer filling
steps.text: Mix the grated paneer with capsicum, green chilli, coriander, chaat masala and a pinch of salt.
steps.visual: A small bowl of grated white paneer mixed with green capsicum bits, coriander and a dusting of chaat masala

steps.title: Beat the eggs
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with black pepper and the remaining salt until smooth.
steps.visual: Two beaten eggs, smooth and pale yellow, speckled with black pepper in a steel bowl

steps.title: Set the omelette
steps.text: Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Pour in the eggs, swirl to cover the pan and cook for 2 minutes until the top is nearly set.
steps.visual: A thin yellow omelette almost set in a non-stick pan, edges lifting slightly

steps.title: Add the filling
steps.text: Spread the paneer filling over one half, fold the other half over and press lightly. Cook for 1 minute per side so the paneer warms through.
steps.visual: A half-moon omelette in the pan with white paneer filling peeking out from the fold

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slide onto a plate and serve hot with sliced cucumber.
steps.visual: A golden half-moon omelette cut open to show the paneer and capsicum filling, on a white plate with cucumber slices

substitutions.note: Grated cheddar melts into a gooier filling.
Crumbled firm tofu keeps it lighter.

recipes.storage: Best eaten fresh.

recipes.title: Spinach–Cheese Egg Muffins (Oven or Air Fryer)
recipes.description: Masala egg muffins packed with spinach, red pepper, spring onion and cheddar, baked in a muffin tin or air-fryer cups. Make a batch for grab-and-go breakfasts.

steps.title: Heat and grease
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C (or the air fryer to 170°C). Grease 6 muffin cups or silicone cups with butter.
steps.visual: Six silicone muffin cups lightly greased with butter on a baking tray

steps.title: Chop the vegetables
steps.text: Finely chop the spinach, dice the red pepper and slice the spring onion and green chilli.
steps.visual: Small piles of chopped green spinach, diced red pepper, sliced spring onion and green chilli on a wooden board

steps.title: Whisk the egg mixture
steps.text: In a mixing bowl whisk the eggs with turmeric, black pepper, chilli flakes and salt. Stir in the vegetables and two-thirds of the cheese.
steps.visual: A steel mixing bowl of beaten golden eggs flecked with green spinach, red pepper and grated cheese

steps.title: Fill the cups
steps.text: Divide the mixture between the cups, filling each about three-quarters full, and top with the remaining cheese.
steps.visual: Six muffin cups three-quarters filled with the colourful egg mixture, grated cheese sprinkled on top

steps.title: Bake until puffed
steps.text: Bake at 180°C for 18 to 20 minutes (air fryer: 170°C for 12 to 14 minutes) until puffed and a toothpick comes out clean.
steps.visual: Puffed, golden egg muffins with lightly browned cheese tops in the muffin cups

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cool for 3 minutes, then unmould. Serve two per person, warm, with green chutney.
steps.visual: Two golden spinach–cheese egg muffins on a plate, one cut open to show the green-flecked inside, a small bowl of green chutney

substitutions.note: Crumbled paneer keeps it milder and less salty.
Chopped methi adds an aromatic bitterness.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate in a box for up to 3 days.
recipes.reheating: Warm in the air fryer at 160°C for 3 minutes or microwave for 30 seconds.

recipes.title: Egg White Masala Bhurji
recipes.description: A high-protein scramble of egg whites (plus one whole egg for colour) with onion, tomato and capsicum masala. Light, filling and ready in fifteen minutes.

steps.title: Separate and whisk
steps.text: Separate the egg whites (save the yolks for another use). Whisk the whites with the whole egg and a pinch of salt.
steps.visual: A steel bowl of loose, foamy egg whites with a single yolk streak, whisk resting on the rim

steps.title: Cook the masala
steps.text: Heat oil in a kadai over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, then onion, ginger and green chilli and sauté for 2 minutes. Add capsicum, tomato, turmeric, chilli powder and the rest of the salt; cook for 3 minutes until soft.
steps.visual: A soft red-orange onion, capsicum and tomato masala in a black kadai

steps.title: Scramble the whites
steps.text: Pour in the egg mixture. Let it set for 20 seconds, then stir and break it into curds for 2 to 3 minutes until just cooked but still moist.
steps.visual: White, fluffy egg curds tinted orange by the masala, being broken up in the kadai

steps.title: Season and finish
steps.text: Sprinkle garam masala and coriander, toss for 30 seconds and switch off the heat.
steps.visual: Fluffy egg white bhurji speckled with green coriander and vegetables in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot on its own, with flaxseed roti, or in lettuce wraps.
steps.visual: Egg white bhurji piled into a white bowl with coriander on top and two lettuce cups beside it

substitutions.note: Use whole eggs if you prefer a richer, less lean scramble.
Ghee adds flavour.

recipes.storage: Best eaten fresh; keeps 1 day refrigerated.
recipes.reheating: Warm briefly in a pan.

recipes.title: Keto Chicken Biryani with Cauliflower Rice
recipes.description: Yoghurt-marinated chicken cooked in a fragrant whole-spice masala, layered with ghee-tossed cauliflower rice, fried onion and mint, then steamed on dum. All the biryani aroma without the rice.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: In a mixing bowl combine the chicken with hung curd, ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri chilli, turmeric, garam masala, lemon juice and salt. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
steps.visual: Chicken thigh pieces coated in a thick orange-red yoghurt marinade in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Rice the cauliflower
steps.text: Pulse the cauliflower florets in a mixer in short bursts, or grate them, until they look like rice grains. Spread on a plate to stay dry.
steps.visual: Fluffy, rice-like grains of cauliflower spread on a large steel plate, a few whole florets beside

steps.title: Fry the onions
steps.text: Heat the ghee in a heavy kadai over medium heat. Fry the sliced onion for 6 to 8 minutes until deep golden. Lift out half for garnish.
steps.visual: Deep golden-brown fried onion slices in ghee in a heavy black kadai, half of them lifted onto a small plate

steps.title: Cook the chicken masala
steps.text: Add the bay leaf, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon and green chillies to the onions for 30 seconds. Add the chicken with all its marinade and cook on medium-high for 5 minutes, then cover and cook on low for 12 minutes, adding the water if it sticks.
steps.visual: Chicken pieces in a thick, red-brown masala with whole spices in the black kadai, oil glistening at the edges

steps.title: Layer the biryani
steps.text: Scatter half the mint and coriander over the chicken. Spread the raw cauliflower rice over the top in an even layer, sprinkle with salt, then the remaining herbs and the reserved fried onion.
steps.visual: A white layer of cauliflower rice covering the chicken in the kadai, topped with green mint, coriander and golden fried onion

steps.title: Steam on dum
steps.text: Cover tightly with a lid and cook on the lowest heat for 10 minutes, so the cauliflower steams in the chicken's aroma without turning mushy.
steps.visual: The black kadai sealed with a heavy lid on a low flame, a wisp of steam escaping at the rim

steps.title: Fluff and serve
steps.text: Gently fold the layers together once with a wide spoon and serve hot with cucumber raita.
steps.visual: Cauliflower biryani heaped on a platter with tender chicken pieces, fried onion, mint leaves and whole spices, a bowl of raita beside it

substitutions.note: Use bone-in mutton; pressure-cook the marinated mutton for 4 whistles before layering.
Regular curd works; cook the masala a few minutes longer to reduce it.
For a vegetarian version add paneer cubes for just 3 minutes before layering.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Sprinkle with a little water and warm covered on low heat or microwave for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Mutton Keema with Jeera Cauliflower Rice
recipes.description: Rich, spiced mutton mince cooked down with onion, tomato and whole cumin, served over cumin-and-ghee cauliflower rice. A hearty one-plate keto dinner.

steps.title: Brown the onion
steps.text: Heat 2 teaspoons of ghee in a kadai over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds, then the onion, and cook for 5 minutes until golden.
steps.visual: Golden chopped onion with cumin seeds in ghee in a black kadai

steps.title: Add aromatics and tomato
steps.text: Stir in ginger-garlic paste and green chilli for 1 minute, then the tomato, chilli powder, coriander powder and turmeric. Cook for 4 minutes until the tomato melts and oil separates.
steps.visual: A thick, dark red masala with oil pooling at the edges in the black kadai

steps.title: Brown the keema
steps.text: Add the mutton mince and salt. Break it up with a spatula and cook on high for 6 to 7 minutes until the mince loses its pink colour and the moisture dries up.
steps.visual: Crumbly mutton mince turning brown and coated in red masala in the black kadai

steps.title: Simmer until tender
steps.text: Pour in the water, cover and simmer on low for 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until the keema is tender and almost dry. Stir in garam masala and coriander.
steps.visual: Dark, glossy, almost dry mutton keema in the kadai, flecked with green coriander

steps.title: Rice the cauliflower
steps.text: While the keema simmers, pulse the cauliflower in a mixer in short bursts or grate it into rice-sized grains.
steps.visual: A steel plate of fluffy cauliflower rice grains beside a mixer jar

steps.title: Cook jeera cauliflower rice
steps.text: Heat the remaining ghee in a non-stick pan, add the remaining cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add the cauliflower rice and salt and stir-fry uncovered on medium-high for 5 minutes until just tender.
steps.visual: Cauliflower rice dotted with toasted cumin seeds being tossed in ghee in a non-stick pan

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the cauliflower rice into bowls and top with the hot keema. Serve with sliced onion and lemon.
steps.visual: A bowl of jeera cauliflower rice topped with a generous mound of dark mutton keema, coriander on top, onion rings and a lemon wedge on the side

substitutions.note: Chicken mince is leaner and cooks in 10 minutes instead of 20.
For a vegetarian version use soaked, minced soya chunks (higher in carbs).
Mustard oil gives a sharper, Punjabi-style keema.

recipes.storage: Keema keeps 3 days refrigerated and freezes for 1 month; make the cauliflower rice fresh.
recipes.reheating: Reheat keema in a pan with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Upma
recipes.description: A South Indian breakfast upma made with grated cauliflower instead of rava — tempered with mustard, urad dal and curry leaves, with peanuts for crunch and coconut to finish.

steps.title: Grate the cauliflower
steps.text: Grate the cauliflower florets or pulse them in a mixer until they look like coarse rava. Squeeze out any excess moisture in a cloth.
steps.visual: A heap of coarse, rava-like grated cauliflower on a steel plate next to a box grater

steps.title: Roast the peanuts
steps.text: Heat oil in a kadai over medium heat and fry the peanuts for 2 minutes until golden. Lift them out and keep aside.
steps.visual: Golden roasted peanuts being lifted out of hot oil in a black kadai with a slotted spoon

steps.title: Temper the spices
steps.text: In the same oil add mustard seeds; when they pop add urad dal and fry until golden, then hing, curry leaves, green chillies, ginger and onion. Sauté for 1 minute.
steps.visual: Popping mustard seeds, golden urad dal, curry leaves, slit green chillies and chopped onion in oil in the kadai

steps.title: Cook the cauliflower
steps.text: Add the grated cauliflower and salt and stir well. Sprinkle the water, cover and cook on low for 4 minutes, then uncover and stir for 2 minutes until soft but not mushy.
steps.visual: Grated cauliflower turning soft and slightly translucent, flecked with mustard seeds and curry leaves in the kadai

steps.title: Finish the upma
steps.text: Switch off the heat. Fold in the coconut, ghee, roasted peanuts, lemon juice and coriander.
steps.visual: Cauliflower upma glistening with ghee, studded with golden peanuts, white coconut and green coriander in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot, with coconut chutney if you like.
steps.visual: A mound of cauliflower upma on a banana leaf with peanuts and curry leaves on top, a small bowl of coconut chutney beside it

substitutions.note: Cashews give a classic hotel-style upma; they add a few more carbs.
Compounded hing contains wheat; skip it or use a gluten-free hing for a gluten-free dish.

recipes.storage: Best eaten fresh; keeps 1 day refrigerated.
recipes.reheating: Stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes in a hot pan.

recipes.title: Zucchini–Paneer Jalfrezi Stir Fry
recipes.description: A quick, colourful stir fry of zucchini half-moons, red pepper and paneer tossed with cumin, garlic and mustard oil. Crunchy, lightly spiced and on the table in 20 minutes.

steps.title: Cut the vegetables
steps.text: Cut the zucchini into thick half-moons, the paneer into batons, the red pepper into strips and the onion into petals.
steps.visual: Green zucchini half-moons, white paneer batons, red pepper strips and onion petals in neat piles on a wooden board

steps.title: Sear the paneer
steps.text: Heat the mustard oil in a kadai until it just smokes, then lower to medium. Sear the paneer batons for 2 minutes until golden on two sides and lift out.
steps.visual: Paneer batons with golden seared edges being lifted out of a black kadai

steps.title: Temper and add vegetables
steps.text: Add cumin seeds, garlic and ginger to the same oil for 30 seconds. Add the onion and pepper and toss on high heat for 2 minutes.
steps.visual: Red pepper strips and onion petals blistering with sliced garlic and ginger in the kadai

steps.title: Stir-fry the zucchini
steps.text: Add the zucchini with turmeric, Kashmiri chilli, coriander powder, black pepper and salt. Toss on high heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the zucchini is tender-crisp, not soft.
steps.visual: Bright green zucchini half-moons coated in red-gold spices, tossed with peppers in the kadai

steps.title: Toss in the paneer
steps.text: Return the paneer, toss for 1 minute, then switch off and add lemon juice and coriander.
steps.visual: Golden paneer batons mixed through the zucchini and pepper stir fry, green coriander scattered over, in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot as a main with almond-flour roti, or as a side for grilled meat.
steps.visual: Zucchini–paneer jalfrezi heaped on a white plate, a colourful mix of green, red and gold, a lemon wedge on the side

substitutions.note: Firm tofu makes it vegan.
Green capsicum or broccoli work in place of zucchini.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 1 day.
recipes.reheating: Toss in a hot pan for 1 minute; don't overcook the zucchini.

recipes.title: Tandoori Fish Tikka
recipes.description: Firm seer-fish cubes in a mustard-oil and hung-curd tandoori marinade, charred in the oven, air fryer or a hot pan. A lean, protein-rich starter or main.

steps.title: First marinade
steps.text: Pat the fish cubes dry and rub them with lemon juice and salt. Set aside for 10 minutes.
steps.visual: Pale seer-fish cubes glistening with lemon juice and salt in a glass mixing bowl

steps.title: Roast the besan
steps.text: Dry-roast the besan in a small pan over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes until it smells nutty. This small amount helps the marinade cling.
steps.visual: A spoonful of lightly golden roasted gram flour in a small steel pan

steps.title: Make the tandoori marinade
steps.text: Whisk the hung curd with roasted besan, ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri chilli, turmeric, tandoori masala, crushed kasuri methi and mustard oil until thick and smooth.
steps.visual: A thick, deep orange-red tandoori marinade in a small steel bowl with a spoon

steps.title: Coat and rest
steps.text: Fold the marinade gently into the fish so each cube is coated. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes (no longer, or the fish softens).
steps.visual: Fish cubes thickly coated in orange-red marinade in the glass bowl, covered with a plate

steps.title: Thread and cook
steps.text: Thread the fish onto skewers. Air fry at 200°C for 10 to 12 minutes, or bake at 220°C for 12 to 14 minutes, until the edges char lightly. On a pan, cook over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side.
steps.visual: Skewers of tandoori fish tikka in an air-fryer basket, the edges charred and the marinade set

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Sprinkle chaat masala over the hot tikka and serve at once with mint chutney and onion rings.
steps.visual: Charred tandoori fish tikka on a wooden board dusted with chaat masala, with mint chutney, onion rings and lemon wedges

substitutions.note: Basa is cheaper but more delicate; marinate only 15 minutes and handle gently.
Use almond flour to make the marinade grain- and pulse-free.
Large prawns make an excellent tandoori prawn; cook 6 to 8 minutes.

recipes.storage: Best eaten fresh; keeps 1 day in the fridge.
recipes.reheating: Warm in the air fryer at 180°C for 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Malai Chicken Tikka
recipes.description: Creamy, mild chicken tikka marinated in cream cheese, cheddar, fresh cream and cardamom, then charred until golden. No chilli powder — just green chilli and pepper warmth.

steps.title: First marinade
steps.text: Toss the chicken with ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt in a mixing bowl. Rest for 15 minutes.
steps.visual: Chicken thigh pieces coated in ginger-garlic paste and lemon juice in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Whip the malai marinade
steps.text: In a separate bowl whisk the cream cheese, grated cheddar, fresh cream and hung curd until smooth, then mix in the green chilli paste, cardamom powder and black pepper.
steps.visual: A thick, ivory-white creamy marinade speckled with black pepper and green chilli in a small bowl

steps.title: Coat and chill
steps.text: Pour the malai marinade over the chicken and mix until every piece is coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
steps.visual: Chicken pieces fully coated in the thick white malai marinade in the steel bowl

steps.title: Skewer and cook
steps.text: Thread the chicken onto skewers. Air fry at 200°C for 14 to 15 minutes, or grill in the oven at 220°C for 18 minutes, turning halfway and basting with melted butter.
steps.visual: Malai tikka skewers in an air fryer, the creamy coating turned golden with brown charred spots and glistening with butter

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slide the tikka off the skewers, scatter with coriander and serve with mint chutney and sliced onion.
steps.visual: Golden, lightly charred malai chicken tikka on a white platter with coriander, onion rings, lemon wedges and green chutney

substitutions.note: Blend paneer with a spoon of cream if you don't have cream cheese.
Breast is leaner; cook 2 minutes less so it stays juicy.
Heavy cream works the same way.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked tikka up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Air fry at 180°C for 3 to 4 minutes.

recipes.title: Reshmi Chicken Kebab
recipes.description: Silky Mughlai kebabs of chicken breast marinated in cashew paste, cream and egg white with gentle green chilli and cardamom. Delicate, juicy and high in protein.

steps.title: Tenderise the chicken
steps.text: Mix the chicken with ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt. Rest for 15 minutes while you soak the cashews in hot water.
steps.visual: Chicken breast cubes coated in ginger-garlic paste in a steel mixing bowl; a small bowl of cashews soaking in water beside

steps.title: Grind the cashew paste
steps.text: Drain the cashews and grind them with the green chillies and 2 tablespoons of the cream to a very smooth paste.
steps.visual: A silky, pale cream cashew and green chilli paste in a small mixer jar

steps.title: Make the reshmi marinade
steps.text: Whisk the cashew paste with the remaining cream, egg white, black pepper, cardamom and garam masala until smooth and light.
steps.visual: A smooth, glossy white marinade being whisked in a bowl, specks of black pepper visible

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Pour the marinade over the chicken, mix well, cover and refrigerate for 2 hours (or up to overnight).
steps.visual: Chicken cubes coated in the silky white marinade in the covered steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Grill until just golden
steps.text: Thread onto skewers, leaving small gaps. Air fry at 190°C for 12 to 14 minutes, or grill in the oven at 220°C for 15 minutes, basting with melted butter halfway. Reshmi kebabs should stay pale with light golden spots — don't over-char.
steps.visual: Pale golden reshmi kebabs with light brown spots on skewers in an air-fryer basket, glistening with butter

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with onion rings, lemon and mint chutney.
steps.visual: Reshmi kebabs on a brass platter with onion rings, lemon wedges and a bowl of mint chutney

substitutions.note: Soaked, peeled almonds make an equally silky paste.
Thigh stays juicier if you tend to overcook breast.
Leave out the egg white for an egg-free kebab; the coating will be slightly less glossy.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked kebabs up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Air fry at 170°C for 3 minutes to keep them soft.

recipes.title: Chicken Seekh Kebab (Air Fryer)
recipes.description: Juicy chicken mince kebabs with ginger, garlic, mint and coriander, shaped on skewers and air-fried until browned — no breadcrumbs or besan needed.

ingredients.prep: very finely chopped and squeezed dry

steps.title: Squeeze the onion
steps.text: Chop the onion very finely and squeeze it in a cloth to remove water — wet onion makes kebabs fall off the skewer.
steps.visual: Finely chopped onion in a muslin cloth being squeezed over a bowl, drops of onion juice falling

steps.title: Knead the kebab mixture
steps.text: In a mixing bowl combine the chicken mince with onion, ginger, garlic, green chilli, coriander, mint, garam masala, Kashmiri chilli, cumin powder and salt. Knead for 3 to 4 minutes until sticky.
steps.visual: Pink chicken mince flecked with green herbs and red spices being kneaded by hand in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Chill the mixture
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes so the mince firms up and is easier to shape.
steps.visual: The covered steel bowl of kebab mixture on a fridge shelf

steps.title: Shape on skewers
steps.text: With wet hands, divide into 6 portions and press each around a skewer into a 5-inch log, squeezing evenly so there are no gaps.
steps.visual: Six long, even logs of herby chicken mince pressed around metal skewers on a tray

steps.title: Air fry
steps.text: Brush with melted butter and air fry at 200°C for 12 to 14 minutes, turning halfway, until browned and cooked through. In an oven, grill at 220°C for 15 to 18 minutes.
steps.visual: Browned chicken seekh kebabs with charred ridges on skewers in an air-fryer basket, glistening with butter

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slide off the skewers, squeeze lemon over, sprinkle chaat masala and serve with mint chutney and onion rings.
steps.visual: Chicken seekh kebabs on a platter dusted with chaat masala, with lemon wedges, onion rings and a small bowl of mint chutney

substitutions.note: Mutton mince gives a richer kebab; add 2 minutes to the cooking time.
Ghee is a fine baste.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; shaped raw kebabs freeze for 1 month.
recipes.reheating: Air fry at 180°C for 4 minutes.

recipes.title: Mutton Seekh Kebab with Raw Papaya
recipes.description: Melt-in-the-mouth mutton seekh kebabs tenderised with a little raw papaya paste and scented with cardamom, black pepper and ghee. Grill, air fry or cook on a tawa.

ingredients.prep: raw green papaya, ground to a paste

steps.title: Make the papaya paste
steps.text: Peel a small piece of raw green papaya and grind it to a smooth paste. Measure 1 tablespoon.
steps.visual: A tablespoon of pale green raw papaya paste in a small steel bowl beside a peeled wedge of green papaya

steps.title: Tenderise the mince
steps.text: In a mixing bowl mix the mutton mince with the papaya paste, ginger-garlic paste and salt. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.
steps.visual: Deep red mutton mince mixed with pale papaya paste in a covered steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Add the spices
steps.text: Add the squeezed onion, green chilli, coriander, chilli powder, garam masala, black pepper, cardamom and crushed kasuri methi. Knead for 4 minutes until the mixture is sticky and holds together.
steps.visual: Sticky, well-kneaded mutton mince speckled with green coriander, chilli and black pepper in the steel bowl

steps.title: Shape the seekhs
steps.text: With wet hands press portions of the mince around skewers into thin, even 5-inch logs.
steps.visual: Six slim mutton kebab logs pressed onto metal skewers on a tray

steps.title: Cook the kebabs
steps.text: Brush with melted ghee. Air fry at 200°C for 14 to 16 minutes or grill in the oven at 230°C for 15 minutes, turning once. On a tawa, roll the skewers over medium-high heat for 10 to 12 minutes.
steps.visual: Dark, charred mutton seekh kebabs sizzling with ghee on skewers in an air-fryer basket

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Rest for 2 minutes, slide off the skewers and serve with onion rings, lemon and mint–curd chutney.
steps.visual: Mutton seekh kebabs on a brass platter with onion rings, lemon wedges and a bowl of mint–curd chutney

substitutions.note: Skip the papaya and chill the mince overnight instead; the kebabs will be slightly firmer.
Chicken mince cooks faster (12 minutes) and needs no papaya.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked kebabs up to 2 days; raw shaped kebabs freeze for 1 month.
recipes.reheating: Air fry at 180°C for 4 minutes or warm on a hot tawa.

recipes.title: Mangalorean Prawn Ghee Roast
recipes.description: Prawns roasted in a fiery, tangy paste of byadgi chillies, coriander, pepper and garlic, slow-cooked in plenty of ghee. Made without the usual jaggery, so it stays sharp and low in carbs.

steps.title: Marinate the prawns
steps.text: Toss the prawns with turmeric, lemon juice and half the salt and set aside for 15 minutes.
steps.visual: Cleaned grey-pink prawns tinted yellow with turmeric in a steel bowl

steps.title: Roast the whole spices
steps.text: In a dry kadai over low heat roast the byadgi chillies, coriander seeds, cumin, pepper and fenugreek for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant and the chillies crisp. Don't let them blacken.
steps.visual: Deep red dried byadgi chillies with coriander seeds, cumin and peppercorns toasting in a dry black kadai

steps.title: Grind the ghee roast paste
steps.text: Cool the spices, then grind with the garlic, tamarind and the water to a very smooth, thick red paste.
steps.visual: A thick, smooth, brick-red masala paste in a mixer jar

steps.title: Sear the prawns
steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in the same kadai on high heat and sear the prawns for 2 minutes until just pink. Lift them out.
steps.visual: Pink, curled prawns sizzling in ghee in the black kadai

steps.title: Roast the masala in ghee
steps.text: Add the remaining ghee and curry leaves, then the red paste and the rest of the salt. Cook on low heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often, until the paste darkens and the ghee separates.
steps.visual: Dark red, glossy masala bubbling in a pool of ghee with crisp curry leaves in the kadai

steps.title: Toss the prawns
steps.text: Return the prawns and toss on medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until coated and cooked through. Don't overcook or they turn rubbery.
steps.visual: Prawns thickly coated in deep red ghee roast masala, glistening with ghee in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot as a starter, or with coconut-flour dosa or cauliflower rice.
steps.visual: Prawn ghee roast in a small clay bowl, deep red and glossy with ghee, curry leaves on top, a lemon wedge beside it

substitutions.note: Chicken ghee roast is the other Mangalorean classic; cook the chicken in the paste for 15 minutes.
Paneer cubes make a vegetarian ghee roast; add them only in the last 2 minutes.
Lemon juice keeps the tang and lowers the carbs further.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Warm gently in a pan; don't overcook the prawns.

recipes.title: Chicken 65 (Air Fryer, No Cornflour)
recipes.description: Chennai's spicy bar snack made lighter: chicken in an egg, curd and chilli marinade, air-fried until crisp-edged, then tossed with garlic, green chilli and curry leaves.

steps.title: Mix the marinade
steps.text: In a mixing bowl whisk the egg, curd, ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri chilli, chilli powder, pepper, garam masala, lemon juice and salt into a thick red paste.
steps.visual: A thick, fiery red marinade in a steel mixing bowl with a whisk resting in it

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken pieces, mix until coated and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
steps.visual: Bite-sized chicken pieces coated in the red egg-and-chilli marinade in the steel bowl

steps.title: Air fry until crisp
steps.text: Brush the air-fryer basket with 1 teaspoon of the oil. Spread the chicken in a single layer and air fry at 200°C for 14 to 16 minutes, shaking halfway, until the edges are crisp and charred. In an oven, bake on a rack at 220°C for 20 minutes.
steps.visual: Deep red chicken pieces with crisp, darkened edges in a single layer in an air-fryer basket

steps.title: Make the tempering
steps.text: Heat the remaining oil in a kadai over medium heat. Add the garlic, green chillies and curry leaves and fry for 1 minute until the leaves crackle and the garlic is golden.
steps.visual: Golden chopped garlic, slit green chillies and crackling curry leaves in oil in a black kadai

steps.title: Toss the chicken
steps.text: Add the air-fried chicken and toss on high heat for 1 minute so the tempering coats every piece.
steps.visual: Crisp red chicken pieces tossed with fried curry leaves and green chillies in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve immediately with onion rings and lemon wedges.
steps.visual: Chicken 65 heaped on a steel plate, bright red and crisp, scattered with fried curry leaves and green chillies, onion rings and lemon wedges beside

substitutions.note: Breast works but dries out faster; air fry 2 minutes less.
Paneer 65 — air fry paneer cubes for 8 to 10 minutes.
Hung curd gives a thicker coating.

recipes.storage: Best eaten fresh; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Air fry at 180°C for 3 to 4 minutes to re-crisp.

recipes.title: Kerala Chicken Coconut Fry
recipes.description: Kozhi varattiyathu-style chicken roasted in coconut oil with shallots, curry leaves, pepper and crisp coconut slivers until dark and dry. Bold, aromatic and low in carbs.

ingredients.prep: fresh coconut cut into thin slivers

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Rub the chicken with turmeric, Kashmiri chilli, coriander powder, half the garam masala and salt. Set aside for 20 minutes.
steps.visual: Bone-in chicken pieces coated in a deep red spice rub in a steel bowl

steps.title: Fry the coconut slivers
steps.text: Heat the coconut oil in a heavy kadai over medium heat. Fry the coconut slivers for 3 to 4 minutes until golden brown. Lift out half for garnish.
steps.visual: Thin coconut slivers turning golden brown in coconut oil in a heavy black kadai, half lifted onto a plate

steps.title: Sauté the aromatics
steps.text: Add fennel seeds, then the shallots, ginger, garlic, green chillies and curry leaves. Sauté for 5 minutes until the shallots are golden.
steps.visual: Golden shallots, ginger, garlic, green chilli and crackling curry leaves with coconut slivers in the kadai

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Add the marinated chicken and toss for 3 minutes. Pour in the water, cover and cook on low for 20 minutes until tender, stirring once or twice.
steps.visual: Chicken pieces simmering in a reddish masala with coconut slivers in the covered kadai

steps.title: Roast until dark
steps.text: Uncover, add the crushed pepper and remaining garam masala and roast on medium-high for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often, until the chicken is dark brown, dry and coated.
steps.visual: Dark brown, dry-roasted chicken with crisp curry leaves and coconut slivers clinging to every piece in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with the reserved fried coconut and serve with coconut-flour dosa, cauliflower rice or a cabbage thoran.
steps.visual: Kerala chicken coconut fry in a clay bowl, dark and glossy, topped with golden coconut slivers and curry leaves, on a banana leaf

substitutions.note: Boneless thigh cooks in 12 minutes covered.
For mutton varattiyathu, pressure-cook the marinated mutton for 5 whistles first.
Onion works if shallots aren't available; shallots are sweeter.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days.
recipes.reheating: Reheat in a pan over medium heat with a few drops of coconut oil.

recipes.title: Dhaba-Style Chicken Saag
recipes.description: Tender chicken simmered in a garlicky purée of spinach and mustard greens, finished with ghee and a little cream. A Punjabi winter curry that's naturally keto and high in protein.

steps.title: Blanch the greens
steps.text: Boil the spinach, mustard greens and green chillies in a saucepan with a splash of water for 4 minutes until wilted. Drain and cool.
steps.visual: Bright green wilted spinach and mustard greens with two green chillies in a steel saucepan

steps.title: Purée the saag
steps.text: Blend the greens with the water to a coarse purée — a little texture is traditional.
steps.visual: A thick, deep green coarse purée of greens in a mixer jar

steps.title: Build the masala
steps.text: Heat ghee in a kadai over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, then onion and cook for 5 minutes until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute, then tomato, turmeric, Kashmiri chilli and coriander powder; cook for 3 minutes until soft.
steps.visual: Golden onion and tomato masala with oil glistening at the edges in a black kadai

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken and salt and cook on medium-high for 5 minutes, turning, until the pieces are sealed and coated.
steps.visual: Chicken pieces coated in red-brown masala, lightly browned, in the black kadai

steps.title: Simmer in the saag
steps.text: Stir in the green purée, cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes until the chicken is tender and the saag thickens. Stir now and then so it doesn't catch.
steps.visual: Chicken pieces half-buried in a thick, bubbling dark green saag in the covered kadai, lid slightly ajar

steps.title: Finish with cream
steps.text: Stir in garam masala and cream and simmer for 1 more minute.
steps.visual: A swirl of white cream being stirred into the green chicken saag in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with almond-flour roti or flaxseed roti and sliced onion.
steps.visual: Chicken saag in a copper handi, deep green with tender chicken and a swirl of cream on top, a flaxseed roti beside it

substitutions.note: Use all spinach if sarson isn't available; the flavour is milder.
Make palak paneer-style saag paneer by adding paneer in the last 3 minutes.
A knob of white butter is the dhaba finish.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days; freezes well for 1 month.
recipes.reheating: Reheat on low with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Achari Paneer Tikka
recipes.description: Paneer, onion and capsicum marinated in mustard oil, hung curd and a coarsely ground pickling masala of fennel, mustard, fenugreek and cumin — tangy, pungent and charred.

steps.title: Roast the achari masala
steps.text: Dry-roast the fennel, mustard, fenugreek and cumin seeds in a small pan over low heat for 1 minute until fragrant. Cool and crush coarsely.
steps.visual: Coarsely crushed fennel, mustard, fenugreek and cumin seeds in a stone mortar

steps.title: Whisk the marinade
steps.text: Warm the mustard oil until it just smokes, then cool for 2 minutes. In a mixing bowl whisk the hung curd with the mustard oil, crushed achari masala, ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri chilli, turmeric, lemon juice and salt.
steps.visual: A thick yellow-orange marinade full of crushed seeds in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Coat the paneer
steps.text: Add the paneer, onion petals and capsicum squares and fold gently until coated.
steps.visual: Paneer cubes, onion petals and capsicum squares coated in speckled orange marinade in the steel bowl

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
steps.visual: The steel bowl of coated paneer and vegetables covered with a plate in the fridge

steps.title: Skewer and char
steps.text: Thread paneer and vegetables alternately onto skewers. Air fry at 200°C for 10 to 12 minutes, turning halfway, or cook on a hot non-stick pan for 2 minutes per side, until charred at the edges.
steps.visual: Achari paneer tikka skewers with charred edges in an air-fryer basket, crushed seeds visible on the crust

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with mint chutney and a squeeze of lemon.
steps.visual: Charred achari paneer tikka pieces on a slate board with onion, capsicum, mint chutney and a lemon wedge

substitutions.note: Use pressed firm tofu and coconut yoghurt for a vegan tikka.
Neutral oil if you dislike mustard oil's pungency, though it's key to the achari taste.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked tikka up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Air fry at 180°C for 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Hariyali Chicken Tikka
recipes.description: Chicken thighs marinated in a vivid green paste of mint, coriander, spinach and green chilli with hung curd, then charred. Fresh, herby and high in protein.

steps.title: Blend the green paste
steps.text: Blend the mint, coriander, spinach, green chillies, ginger-garlic paste and lemon juice to a smooth, thick paste with no added water.
steps.visual: A vivid emerald-green herb paste in a mixer jar

steps.title: Make the marinade
steps.text: In a mixing bowl stir the green paste into the hung curd with garam masala, roasted cumin powder, mustard oil and salt.
steps.visual: A thick, pale green yoghurt marinade in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, up to overnight.
steps.visual: Chicken pieces coated in thick green marinade in the covered steel bowl

steps.title: Skewer and cook
steps.text: Thread the chicken onto skewers. Air fry at 200°C for 14 to 15 minutes, turning halfway, or grill in the oven at 220°C for 18 minutes, until lightly charred and cooked through.
steps.visual: Green-coated chicken tikka on skewers in an air-fryer basket, edges charred dark

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Sprinkle chaat masala over the hot tikka and serve with onion rings, lemon and cucumber raita.
steps.visual: Hariyali chicken tikka on a platter, deep green with charred spots, dusted with chaat masala, with onion rings and lemon wedges

substitutions.note: Hariyali paneer tikka — marinate 30 minutes and cook 10 minutes.
Strain regular curd for 1 hour first or the marinade will be runny.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked tikka up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Air fry at 180°C for 3 to 4 minutes.

recipes.title: Keto Almond-Flour Roti
recipes.description: Soft, pliable rotis made from almond flour and psyllium husk that roll out and puff on a tawa much like phulka. Serve with any curry or sabzi.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.text: In a mixing bowl whisk together the almond flour, psyllium husk and salt so the psyllium is evenly spread.
steps.visual: Pale almond flour mixed with fine psyllium husk in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Pour in the warm water and mix with a spoon, then knead for 1 minute into a soft dough. Rest for 10 minutes — it firms up as the psyllium gels.
steps.visual: A smooth, slightly sticky ball of pale beige dough in the steel bowl

steps.title: Roll the rotis
steps.text: Divide into 4 balls. Roll each between two sheets of baking paper into a 6-inch circle; trim with a lid for neat edges if you like.
steps.visual: A thin, round almond-flour roti rolled between two sheets of baking paper, three more dough balls waiting beside

steps.title: Cook on the tawa
steps.text: Heat a tawa over medium heat. Peel off one sheet, flip the roti onto the tawa and peel off the other. Cook for 1 to 1½ minutes per side until brown spots appear; press the edges with a cloth to help it puff.
steps.visual: A roti puffing up on a black iron tawa with golden-brown spots

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Brush with ghee and keep wrapped in a cloth. Serve warm with any curry.
steps.visual: A stack of four almond-flour rotis glistening with ghee in a cloth-lined basket

substitutions.note: For nut-free rotis use about 30 g coconut flour and add 2 tbsp extra water.
Use coconut oil to make it vegan.

recipes.storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature for a day or refrigerate up to 3 days.
recipes.reheating: Warm on a hot tawa for 20 seconds per side.

recipes.title: Flaxseed Roti
recipes.description: Nutty, high-fibre rotis made with ground flaxseed, a little psyllium, cumin and coriander. Hearty enough to scoop up dal-style curries and sabzis.

steps.title: Grind the flaxseed
steps.text: Grind the flaxseed in a dry mixer jar to a fine meal. Don't over-grind or it turns oily.
steps.visual: Fine, golden-brown flaxseed meal in a dry mixer jar

steps.title: Cook the dough
steps.text: Bring the water to a boil in a saucepan. Turn the heat to low, add the flax meal, psyllium, cumin seeds, coriander and salt and stir for 1 minute until it gathers into a ball.
steps.visual: A thick ball of dark flax dough flecked with green coriander gathering in a steel saucepan

steps.title: Knead and rest
steps.text: Tip into a mixing bowl and, when cool enough to handle, knead for 1 minute until smooth. Rest for 5 minutes.
steps.visual: A smooth, dark brown dough ball resting in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Roll out
steps.text: Divide into 4 balls and roll each between two sheets of baking paper into a 5- to 6-inch roti.
steps.visual: A round, speckled brown flax roti between two sheets of baking paper

steps.title: Cook on the tawa
steps.text: Cook each roti on a hot tawa over medium heat for 1½ minutes per side until firm with light brown spots.
steps.visual: A flax roti on a hot black iron tawa, firm with brown spots

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Brush lightly with ghee and serve warm.
steps.visual: Four dark, speckled flax rotis brushed with ghee in a cloth-lined basket next to a bowl of curry

substitutions.note: Use coconut oil to keep it vegan.
Ground chia binds the dough too, though the rotis are slightly more fragile.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days, wrapped.
recipes.reheating: Warm on a tawa for 20 seconds per side.

recipes.title: Coconut-Flour Egg Dosa
recipes.description: Thin, lacy dosas made from coconut flour, eggs and coconut milk, scented with cumin. They pair well with chutney, prawn ghee roast or chicken fry.

steps.title: Whisk the wet ingredients
steps.text: In a mixing bowl whisk the eggs, coconut milk and water until smooth.
steps.visual: A pale yellow mixture of eggs and coconut milk being whisked in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: Whisk in the coconut flour, psyllium, cumin seeds and salt until lump-free. Rest for 5 minutes; the batter should be like thin dosa batter — add a spoon of water if too thick.
steps.visual: A smooth, pourable cream-coloured batter dotted with cumin seeds in the steel bowl, ladle resting in it

steps.title: Spread the dosa
steps.text: Heat a tawa over medium heat and wipe with a little coconut oil. Pour a small ladle of batter and gently spread into a 6-inch circle — it's more delicate than rice batter, so don't press hard.
steps.visual: A thin round of pale batter spread on a black iron tawa, edges just starting to set

steps.title: Cook both sides
steps.text: Drizzle a few drops of oil around the edge and cook for 1½ minutes until golden underneath, then flip and cook 30 seconds more. Repeat to make 6 dosas.
steps.visual: A golden, lacy coconut-flour dosa flipped on the tawa, a small stack of finished dosas on a plate beside

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot, two per person, with coconut chutney or a keto curry.
steps.visual: Two folded golden coconut-flour dosas on a banana leaf with a small bowl of white coconut chutney

substitutions.note: Thin fresh cream with water for a dairy version.
Use about 75 g almond flour for a softer, nuttier dosa.

recipes.storage: Batter keeps 1 day refrigerated; cooked dosas are best fresh.
recipes.reheating: Warm on a tawa for 20 seconds per side.

recipes.title: Gobi Paratha with Almond–Psyllium Dough
recipes.description: Stuffed cauliflower parathas with a spiced, gingery gobi filling wrapped in an almond-flour and psyllium dough, cooked on a tawa with ghee. Serve with curd or pickle.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: In a mixing bowl whisk the almond flour, psyllium and salt, then add the warm water and knead for 1 minute into a soft dough. Rest for 10 minutes.
steps.visual: A smooth ball of pale beige almond dough resting in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Grate and dry the cauliflower
steps.text: Grate the cauliflower finely and squeeze it hard in a cloth to remove moisture — wet filling tears the parathas.
steps.visual: Finely grated cauliflower in a cotton cloth being squeezed, a small puddle of liquid below

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.text: Toast cumin seeds in a dry kadai for 30 seconds, add the cauliflower, green chilli and ginger and stir on medium heat for 3 minutes until dry. Off the heat mix in coriander, garam masala, chilli powder and salt. Cool completely.
steps.visual: Dry, spiced grated cauliflower flecked with green coriander and cumin in a black kadai

steps.title: Stuff the parathas
steps.text: Divide the dough and filling into 4 portions. Flatten a dough ball on baking paper into a 4-inch disc, place filling in the centre, bring the edges up to seal, then press flat and roll gently between two sheets of baking paper into a 6-inch paratha.
steps.visual: A stuffed paratha being rolled between baking-paper sheets, flecks of green filling showing faintly through the thin dough

steps.title: Cook on the tawa
steps.text: Cook each paratha on a hot tawa over medium heat for 2 minutes per side, then brush with ghee and cook 30 seconds more on each side until golden and crisp-spotted.
steps.visual: A golden gobi paratha with brown crisp spots, glistening with ghee, on a black iron tawa

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with thick curd, a dab of butter or green chutney.
steps.visual: A golden gobi paratha cut into quarters on a steel plate showing the cauliflower filling, a bowl of curd and a spoon of pickle beside it

substitutions.note: Nut-free dough: use about 40 g coconut flour and an extra 2 tbsp water.
Grated paneer makes a paneer paratha with more protein.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked parathas up to 2 days, layered with baking paper.
recipes.reheating: Warm on a tawa for 30 seconds per side.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Masala
recipes.description: Button mushrooms seared until golden, then simmered in a buttery onion–tomato masala finished with cream and kasuri methi. A rich, keto-friendly vegetarian curry.

steps.title: Clean the mushrooms
steps.text: Wipe the mushrooms with a damp cloth (don't soak them) and halve or quarter them so the pieces are even.
steps.visual: Halved and quartered white button mushrooms in a pile on a wooden board

steps.title: Sear the mushrooms
steps.text: Melt half the butter in a kadai over high heat. Add the mushrooms in a single layer and cook for 5 to 6 minutes without stirring too often, until their water evaporates and they turn golden. Lift out.
steps.visual: Golden-brown seared mushrooms in foaming butter in a black kadai

steps.title: Make the masala
steps.text: Add the remaining butter and cumin seeds, then the onion; cook for 3 minutes. Add ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute, then the tomato purée, turmeric, Kashmiri chilli, coriander powder and salt. Cook for 5 minutes until thick and the butter separates.
steps.visual: Thick, glossy red-orange masala with butter pooling at the edges in the black kadai

steps.title: Simmer with cream
steps.text: Stir in the cream and water and bring to a gentle simmer. Return the mushrooms and cook on low for 4 minutes.
steps.visual: Golden mushrooms in a creamy orange gravy gently bubbling in the kadai

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Add garam masala and crushed kasuri methi, stir and switch off the heat. Scatter coriander.
steps.visual: Creamy mushroom masala in the kadai topped with chopped coriander and flecks of kasuri methi

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with almond-flour roti or flaxseed roti.
steps.visual: Mushroom masala in a white bowl with a swirl of cream and coriander, two almond-flour rotis beside it

substitutions.note: Coconut milk with oil in place of butter makes it dairy-free.
Swap half the mushrooms for paneer to add protein.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Warm gently on low with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Soya Chunk Keema
recipes.description: A high-protein vegetarian keema made from soaked, minced soya chunks cooked in a spiced onion–tomato masala with a few peas. Great with roti or in lettuce wraps.

steps.title: Soak the soya chunks
steps.text: Boil a large saucepan of water, add the soya chunks and simmer for 5 minutes. Drain, cool under running water and squeeze out as much water as possible.
steps.visual: Swollen, pale beige soya chunks being squeezed by hand over a steel saucepan

steps.title: Mince the soya
steps.text: Pulse the squeezed chunks in a mixer 3 or 4 times (or chop finely) until they look like coarse mince.
steps.visual: Coarse, crumbly minced soya in a mixer jar, resembling meat keema

steps.title: Brown the onion
steps.text: Heat ghee in a kadai over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, then onion and cook for 5 minutes until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilli and stir for 1 minute.
steps.visual: Golden onion with ginger-garlic paste and green chilli in ghee in a black kadai

steps.title: Cook the masala
steps.text: Add tomato, turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and salt. Cook for 4 minutes until the tomato breaks down and oil separates.
steps.visual: A thick, glossy red masala in the black kadai

steps.title: Simmer the keema
steps.text: Add the minced soya, peas and the measured water. Stir, cover and simmer on low for 7 minutes, then uncover and cook until dry, about 2 minutes.
steps.visual: Brown soya keema with green peas, almost dry, in the kadai

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in garam masala, lemon juice and coriander.
steps.visual: Soya keema scattered with fresh green coriander in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with flaxseed roti, or spooned into lettuce cups with sliced onion.
steps.visual: Soya chunk keema in a steel bowl with coriander and a lemon wedge, lettuce cups and a flaxseed roti beside it

substitutions.note: Leave out the peas to trim carbs further.
Use oil to make it vegan.
Crumbled paneer makes a richer paneer keema.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days.
recipes.reheating: Warm in a pan with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Kerala Soya Chunk Roast
recipes.description: Soya chunks roasted Kerala-style in coconut oil with shallots, coconut slivers, curry leaves, pepper and meat masala until dark and spicy — a protein-rich vegetarian take on beef ularthiyathu.

ingredients.prep: fresh coconut cut into thin slivers

steps.title: Boil the soya chunks
steps.text: Boil the soya chunks in plenty of water with turmeric and a pinch of salt for 6 minutes. Drain, rinse in cold water and squeeze out the water firmly.
steps.visual: Swollen golden soya chunks draining in a steel colander over a saucepan

steps.title: Fry the coconut
steps.text: Heat coconut oil in a kadai over medium heat and fry the coconut slivers for 3 minutes until golden.
steps.visual: Thin coconut slivers turning golden in coconut oil in a black kadai

steps.title: Sauté the aromatics
steps.text: Add the fennel seeds, shallots, ginger, garlic, green chilli and curry leaves and sauté for 4 minutes until the shallots are golden.
steps.visual: Golden shallots, ginger, garlic and crisp curry leaves with coconut slivers in the kadai

steps.title: Add the spices
steps.text: Lower the heat and add Kashmiri chilli, coriander powder, meat masala and the rest of the salt. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant, adding a splash of the water if it sticks.
steps.visual: Shallots and coconut coated in a dark red-brown spice paste in the kadai

steps.title: Roast the soya
steps.text: Add the squeezed soya chunks and the water, cover and cook for 5 minutes. Uncover, add the crushed pepper and roast on medium-high for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often, until dark and dry.
steps.visual: Dark brown, dry-roasted soya chunks coated in masala with coconut slivers and curry leaves in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with coconut-flour dosa or as a side with cauliflower rice.
steps.visual: Kerala soya roast in a clay bowl, dark and glossy, with curry leaves and golden coconut slivers on top

substitutions.note: Any oil works, though coconut oil gives the Kerala flavour.
Garam masala is a fine stand-in.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days.
recipes.reheating: Warm in a pan with a few drops of coconut oil.

recipes.title: Masala Tofu Bhurji
recipes.description: A vegan scramble of crumbled firm tofu with onion, tomato, capsicum and turmeric, with a pinch of kala namak for an eggy note. High in protein and ready in 15 minutes.

steps.title: Press and crumble the tofu
steps.text: Wrap the tofu in a clean cloth and press under a heavy pan for 10 minutes to remove water, then crumble it with your fingers.
steps.visual: A block of firm tofu wrapped in a cloth under a heavy pan, a bowl of crumbled white tofu beside it

steps.title: Sauté the aromatics
steps.text: Heat oil in a kadai over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, then onion, ginger, garlic and green chilli; cook for 2 minutes until soft.
steps.visual: Soft, translucent onion with ginger, garlic and green chilli in oil in a black kadai

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Add capsicum, tomato, turmeric, Kashmiri chilli, coriander powder and salt. Cook for 3 minutes until the tomato softens.
steps.visual: A soft yellow-red masala with capsicum pieces in the kadai

steps.title: Scramble the tofu
steps.text: Add the crumbled tofu and toss on medium-high for 3 to 4 minutes until it turns evenly yellow and any moisture dries off.
steps.visual: Bright yellow crumbled tofu tossed through the vegetables in the kadai, looking like scrambled egg

steps.title: Season and finish
steps.text: Sprinkle kala namak and coriander, toss and switch off the heat.
steps.visual: Tofu bhurji flecked with green coriander in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with flaxseed roti or lettuce wraps.
steps.visual: Golden-yellow tofu bhurji in a white bowl with coriander on top and a flaxseed roti beside it

substitutions.note: Paneer makes a vegetarian (not vegan) bhurji.
Mustard oil adds a sharper flavour.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Warm in a pan for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Hung-Curd Raita Bowl with Toasted Seeds
recipes.description: Thick, creamy hung curd with cucumber, mint and roasted cumin, topped with toasted pumpkin, sunflower and flax seeds and a ghee–mustard tadka. A protein-rich snack or light lunch.

steps.title: Whisk the curd
steps.text: Whisk the hung curd in a mixing bowl until smooth and creamy.
steps.visual: Thick, glossy white hung curd being whisked smooth in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Fold in cucumber and herbs
steps.text: Grate the cucumber, squeeze out the juice, and fold it into the curd with mint, coriander, roasted cumin, black salt, pepper and salt.
steps.visual: Creamy white raita streaked with pale green cucumber and flecks of mint and coriander in the steel bowl

steps.title: Toast the seeds
steps.text: Dry-toast the pumpkin, sunflower and flax seeds in a kadai over medium-low heat for 3 minutes until the pumpkin seeds puff and pop. Tip onto a plate.
steps.visual: Puffed green pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds and brown flax seeds toasting in a dry black kadai

steps.title: Make the tadka
steps.text: Heat the ghee in the same kadai, add mustard seeds and let them pop, then add curry leaves and chilli powder and switch off the heat at once.
steps.visual: Popping mustard seeds and crisp curry leaves in red-tinged ghee in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Divide the raita between two bowls, pour over the tadka and scatter the toasted seeds on top. Eat straight away so the seeds stay crunchy.
steps.visual: Two bowls of thick cucumber raita topped with a red ghee tadka, curry leaves and a crunchy scatter of toasted seeds

substitutions.note: Strain regular curd for 2 hours to make your own hung curd.
Chopped toasted almonds work instead of pumpkin seeds.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate the raita (without seeds and tadka) for up to 1 day.

recipes.title: Tandoori Chicken Tikka Salad
recipes.description: Tandoori-spiced chicken breast seared or air-fried, sliced over crisp lettuce, cucumber, tomato and onion with a tangy hung-curd and chaat masala dressing.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: In a mixing bowl coat the chicken strips with curd, ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri chilli, tandoori masala, lemon juice, salt and olive oil. Rest for 30 minutes in the fridge.
steps.visual: Chicken breast strips coated in a red tandoori marinade in a glass mixing bowl

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Air fry at 200°C for 10 to 12 minutes, turning halfway, or sear in a hot non-stick pan for 4 minutes per side, until charred and cooked through. Rest for 3 minutes, then slice.
steps.visual: Charred tandoori chicken strips resting on a board, one sliced to show juicy white meat

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the hung curd with lemon juice, olive oil, chaat masala, black pepper and torn mint until smooth and pourable.
steps.visual: A small bowl of creamy pale dressing flecked with mint and chaat masala

steps.title: Build the salad
steps.text: Arrange the lettuce, cucumber, tomato and onion in a wide bowl and top with the sliced chicken.
steps.visual: A wide salad bowl of green lettuce, cucumber slices, tomato wedges and onion rings topped with charred chicken slices

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drizzle the dressing over, scatter coriander and serve at once.
steps.visual: Chicken tikka salad drizzled with white mint dressing and coriander leaves, a lemon wedge on the rim of the bowl

substitutions.note: Thighs are juicier and more forgiving.
Use paneer for a vegetarian salad.
Mustard oil in the marinade gives a more tandoori flavour.

recipes.storage: Store cooked chicken and dressing separately in the fridge for up to 2 days; dress the salad just before eating.
recipes.reheating: Serve the chicken cold or warm it in the air fryer for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Chatpata Paneer Tikka Salad Bowl
recipes.description: Pan-seared paneer in a curd-free marinade of mustard oil, lemon, black pepper, chaat masala and kasuri methi, over crunchy cabbage, cucumber and red pepper with a mint–curd dressing.

steps.title: Marinate the paneer
steps.text: In a mixing bowl toss the paneer cubes with mustard oil, lemon juice, grated garlic, crushed pepper, chaat masala, crushed kasuri methi, chilli flakes and salt. Rest for 15 minutes.
steps.visual: Paneer cubes glossy with mustard oil and speckled with black pepper, chilli flakes and dried fenugreek in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Chop the salad
steps.text: Finely shred the cabbage and dice the cucumber and red pepper.
steps.visual: Shredded pale green cabbage, diced cucumber and diced red pepper in three piles on a wooden board

steps.title: Make the mint dressing
steps.text: Whisk the hung curd with chopped mint, lemon juice, olive oil and a pinch of salt.
steps.visual: A small bowl of thick, mint-green curd dressing

steps.title: Sear the paneer
steps.text: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and sear the paneer in a single layer for 1½ to 2 minutes per side until golden with charred spots.
steps.visual: Paneer cubes with golden, charred faces sizzling in a non-stick pan, peppercorns visible on the crust

steps.title: Assemble the bowl
steps.text: Divide the cabbage, cucumber and red pepper between two bowls and top with the hot paneer.
steps.visual: Two bowls of crunchy cabbage, cucumber and red pepper topped with golden seared paneer cubes

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the mint dressing over, scatter toasted pumpkin seeds and serve.
steps.visual: A paneer tikka salad bowl with spoonfuls of green mint dressing and a scatter of pumpkin seeds, a lemon wedge on the side

substitutions.note: Firm tofu makes it vegan; use coconut yoghurt in the dressing.
Lettuce makes a softer, lighter bowl.

recipes.storage: Keep paneer, salad and dressing separately in the fridge for up to 1 day.
recipes.reheating: Warm the paneer in a pan for 1 minute before assembling.

recipes.title: Cardamom Coconut Chia Pudding
recipes.description: Chia seeds set overnight in coconut milk with cardamom and a sugar-free sweetener, topped with toasted coconut, almonds and pistachios. A make-ahead breakfast or dessert.

steps.title: Whisk the coconut base
steps.text: In a mixing bowl whisk the coconut milk, water, erythritol and cardamom until the sweetener dissolves.
steps.visual: Creamy white coconut milk being whisked in a steel bowl, specks of cardamom on the surface

steps.title: Stir in the chia
steps.text: Add the chia seeds and whisk well. Wait 5 minutes and whisk again to break up any clumps.
steps.visual: Black and white chia seeds suspended in coconut milk in the steel bowl, whisk resting on the rim

steps.title: Chill to set
steps.text: Divide between two glasses or jars, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight until thick and spoonable.
steps.visual: Two glass jars of set, speckled chia pudding on a fridge shelf

steps.title: Toast the toppings
steps.text: Toast the desiccated coconut and slivered almonds in a dry kadai over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until golden.
steps.visual: Golden toasted coconut and slivered almonds in a dry black kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top each pudding with toasted coconut, almonds and chopped pistachios and serve chilled.
steps.visual: Two jars of cardamom chia pudding topped with toasted coconut, almond slivers and green pistachios

substitutions.note: A few drops or a pinch of pure stevia replaces the erythritol.
Thin heavy cream with water for a dairy version.
Use pumpkin seeds for a nut-free topping.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate, covered, for up to 3 days (add toppings just before serving).

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Coconut Ladoo
recipes.description: Soft, fragrant coconut ladoos cooked with cream, ghee and cardamom and sweetened with erythritol instead of sugar or condensed milk. Two small ladoos make a serving.

steps.title: Powder the sweetener
steps.text: Grind the erythritol in a dry mixer jar to a fine powder so the ladoos aren't gritty.
steps.visual: Fine white powdered erythritol in a small dry mixer jar

steps.title: Toast the coconut
steps.text: Heat the ghee in a kadai over low heat and add the desiccated coconut. Stir for 3 to 4 minutes until fragrant but still white — don't let it brown.
steps.visual: Fragrant white desiccated coconut being stirred in a little ghee in a black kadai

steps.title: Cook with cream
steps.text: Pour in the cream and the powdered erythritol. Stir continuously on low for 5 to 6 minutes until the mixture is moist, comes together and leaves the sides of the pan.
steps.visual: A moist, clumping coconut mixture pulling away from the sides of the kadai

steps.title: Add cardamom and cool
steps.text: Stir in the cardamom powder, switch off the heat and let the mixture cool for 5 minutes until warm enough to handle.
steps.visual: The coconut mixture spread on a steel plate to cool, specks of cardamom visible

steps.title: Shape the ladoos
steps.text: Grease your palms with a drop of ghee, take a tablespoon of the mixture and press and roll into a firm ball. Make 12 ladoos.
steps.visual: Twelve neat white coconut ladoos lined up on a steel plate, a few still being rolled

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Let the ladoos set for 15 minutes, then serve two per person. They firm up further in the fridge.
steps.visual: Coconut ladoos arranged on a brass plate, a couple rolled in extra desiccated coconut

substitutions.note: Use thick coconut milk and coconut oil for dairy-free ladoos; cook 2 minutes longer.
A pinch of pure stevia works, but erythritol gives better body.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate in an airtight box for up to 5 days.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Badam Halwa
recipes.description: A glossy, ghee-rich almond halwa made with ground blanched almonds, milk and a little cream, sweetened with erythritol and scented with cardamom. A small festive serving with far fewer carbs than the classic.

steps.title: Peel the almonds
steps.text: Soak the almonds overnight (or in hot water for 30 minutes), then slip off the skins.
